subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Go the extra mile
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Go the extra mile"** is an idiom that means to make more effort than is expected of you (सामान्य से अधिक प्रयास करना)
 
• **"Do much more than required"** (Option 1) accurately represents the meaning of this idiom (अनिवार्यतः अधिक करना)

Therefore, the** correct answer **is- *'Do much more than required'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Spend more money than required"** (Option 2),** "Walk more than required"** (Option 3)**, and "Talk more than required" **(Option 4) **do not adequately capture the meaning of the idiom "Go the extra mile".
